visualReview.notes: Actually inspected107 final images:17 portable,17 shared-material,33 medium-fi lighting/LOD and40 normal-placement terrain views. Current-round primary pixels were four regional heritage photographs (full front, angled gateway, courtyard trifora, corbelled gallery/statue/arms) and three restoration contractor photographs (ducal arcade/pool, round bastion/curtain, Arms Court/roofed wallwalks). Unequal Filarete stages, clock, real open belfry, octagonal loggia and cupola, city gate, two stone round bastions, three square towers, museum ranges and three roofless courts remain distinct. A backward-facing courtyard window was corrected; dedicated court-facing views show its three lights and pale mullions. Ponticella piers survive all tiers, arches return near the viewer. Mapped Santo Spirito ruin appears at street/close-up; its wall heights/profile are reconstructed. Near-view columns and open arcade voids remain visible. Figurative sculpture, inscriptions and detailed frescoes are abstract reserves/excluded. Temporary scaffolding in contractor photos is excluded. No exact2026 condition survey is claimed. Portable/style scenes use an uncut diagnostic terrain raster; flat shared scene is diagnostic. Ground contact is approved from the separate normal-placement images with actual reversible opening.
